description.value: At 5th level, the gambler masters an unconventional combat technique, transforming currency into deadly projectiles. Coins (gil, gro, or MGP) become classified as thrown ammunition. Gil deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage, gro deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage, both with a range increment of 20 feet (Ex). MGP coins possess a range increment of 30 feet, target touch AC, and deal 1d6 non-elemental damage, adding the gambler's Charisma modifier to damage in place of Strength or Dexterity; MGP coins are lost upon being thrown even when missing (Su).
